name: tellurion
description: The live instrument for the project in this window: its products as planets, their features as moons, and the plan as the spine. One instance per project, opened as a panel beside your code.

tellurion.serverPath.description: Path to live-artifact/server.mjs. Left empty, the extension looks for it inside this workspace, then at ~/projects/Organizing-Claude-Code/live-artifact/server.mjs.

tellurion.portRange.description: Ports the extension may use. It reuses a server already watching this folder before starting a new one.

tellurion.autoStart.description: Start an instrument for this folder if none is already watching it.
